mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID, USER_ID, ADMIN_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT, CLOSED_AT FROM CHAT_ROOMS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS IN ('WAITING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGES (ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ID, CONTENT, IS_READ, CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGES WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC

SELECT cr.ROOM_ID, cr.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, cr.ADMIN_ID, cr.STATUS, cr.CREATED_AT, cr.CLOSED_AT, (SELECT m.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGES m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = cr.ROOM_ID ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE FROM CHAT_ROOMS cr INNER JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = cr.USER_ID WHERE cr.STATUS = #{status}
ORDER BY cr.CREATED_AT ASC ORDER BY cr.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT cr.ROOM_ID, cr.USER_ID, u.NICKNAME, cr.ADMIN_ID, cr.STATUS, cr.CREATED_AT, cr.CLOSED_AT, (SELECT m.CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGES m WHERE m.ROOM_ID = cr.ROOM_ID ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE FROM CHAT_ROOMS cr INNER JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = cr.USER_ID WHERE cr.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_ROOMS WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_ROOMS SET ADMIN_ID = #{adminId}, STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CHAT_MESSAGES m INNER JOIN CHAT_ROOMS r ON r.ROOM_ID = m.ROOM_ID WHERE r.ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND r.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND m.SENDER_ID != #{adminId} AND m.IS_READ = FALSE
